dedupe_keys.name: statistical office of the slovak republic 2021 population and housing census sodb 2021 dwelling tables on sewerage system gas connection piped water and heating by municipality with a 1 km grid of dwellings as an arcgis feature service

description: The Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic ran the 2021 Population and Housing Census (SODB 2021) and publishes extended results for dwellings as downloadable report packages. Each package holds CSV files for the whole country, areas, regions, districts and every municipality and urban part, cross-classifying dwellings by type of house with one equipment variable: type of sewerage system, gas connection, type of heating, energy source for heating or piped water. Nationally 1,559,500 of 2,235,586 dwellings were connected to the public sewage system, 536,667 used a cesspool and 88,934 had no sewage; 1,701,466 had a gas connection. A companion ArcGIS feature service gives dwelling counts by region, district and municipality and a 1 km grid with 49,969 cells split into family houses and residential buildings. Format and access: free ZIP downloads and a public REST service with query support. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the report finder needs JavaScript, so the ZIP links were read from its script; small categories include not stated values. Simulation uses: dwelling demand on gas, sewer and water networks by municipality, and the grid for exposure overlays. Related records: the Czech census 2021 open data on houses and dwellings and the Hungary census 2022 dwelling equipment series.

schema_summary: Each report ZIP holds semicolon CSV files at five levels (SR, OL area, KR region, OK district, OB municipality) with codes and names of each level, type of house (family house, residential building, mobile house, institutional and other), the equipment variable (type of sewerage system: public sewer, private treatment plant, cesspool, none, not stated; gas connection yes/no; type of heating; piped water) and an absolute count. Grid layer: cell code, dwellings in family houses, dwellings in residential buildings, dwellings total, polygon geometry
